text:
maria: Citrine Dynamics just sent their RFP back — they want a 6-week POC, data residency in EU, HSM-backed keys, and the ability to run a demo VM on their network for integration tests. can we do an on-premish demo + private control plane?

josh: quick Q: what's the expected QPS / tokens/sec for the POC? also need model family (gpt-like vs encoder-heavy) to size the GPU.

maria: they said ~200 req/min with average 400 tokens per request (chat style), peak bursts to 1k req/min. model preference: open LLM, want quantized 16-bit or 8-bit if possible.

ana: tagging @ana — can we support a demo VM that mirrors Redwood Private but with restricted feature set? I can prepare a trimmed capability matrix and a slimmed config for firewall reviewers.

ana: draft capability matrix snippet (CSV):
```
feature,offerings,notes
private_control_plane,yes,customer-managed VPC peering or on-prem package
hsm_integration,yes,KMIP/HSM or cloud KMS with BYOK
dedicated_gpu_pools,yes,reserved pool for POC with autoscale off
data_residency,eu,region pinned for the demo
slim_runtime,yes,subset image with telemetry disabled for air-gapped eval
```

josh: that looks good. for pricing — two practical options to propose to Citrine:
- hosted POC (usage): estimated ~0.26$/k token -> rough cost 0.26 * (200 req/min * 400 tokens * 60 min * 60 * 24 * 7 * 6) => but we'll present monthly buckets instead.
- dedicated short-term reserve: one-week commit per pod + small infra fee and remote support.

maria: can you do a quick back-of-envelope and post numbers we can share with the buyer tomorrow? they need a ballpark for procurement.

josh: back-of-envelope:
- Hosted (metered): ~ $3,400/month (POC throughput profile, variable) — includes infra + support.
- Dedicated reserve (1xV100-equivalent pool for POC, 6 weeks): ~$18,000 upfront + $1k/wk support.
Numbers approximate; I'll add assumptions in the doc.

dave: legal flags: need an NDA + DPA addendum for the POC (EU residency). also if they're asking HSM/BYOK for keys, we need to confirm accepted vendors and SLA on key rotation. I can draft the DPA addendum, pls confirm contact at Citrine.

maria: contact is emma@citrinedynamics.com, procurement lead. I'll request the NDA now.

ana: security questionnaire — they're mostly standard. I drafted two short answers we can paste into their form: 
- "Data at rest encryption": "All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. For Private deployments we support HSM/BYOK integrations (KMIP compatible)."
- "Access controls": "RBAC in Console, token-level audit logs, and optional IP allowlists for POC network endpoints."

maria: perfect. can you attach that draft QA and the capability matrix to the RFP packet?

ana: uploaded: https://drive.redwood/internal/citrine/poc-capability-matrix-v1.pdf (internal link) and pasted the short security snippets in the doc.

deploy-bot: Demo env request queued (env-12345). ETA ~2h. Note: this uses trimmed runtime image with telemetry disabled per request.

josh: also add a short runbook for the client's infra team: steps for VPC peering, CIDR whitelist, and a `curl` check for readiness. Example snippet:
```
# VPC peering sanity
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://demo.internal.redwood/env-12345/health
```

maria: procurement asked about SLOs for the POC (latency/uptime). what do we commit for a 6-week POC?

josh: propose "best-effort" latency SLO of p95 < 350ms on the dedicated pool, with escalation path and rollback to hosted in case of capacity shortfall. call it "POC operational target" not a full SLA.

dave: agree. label it "operational target" and include failure modes and acceptance criteria in the SOW.

maria: final ask — can billing produce an invoice template for the dedicated 6-week option we can hand to procurement?

josh: ops/billing will do that. I'll ping them after we lock numbers.

maria: ok team — I'll send the RFP packet (cap matrix + security snippets + rough pricing) to Citrine tomorrow 09:00 PT. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ana: I'll follow up with the trimmed runtime image manifest and the list of allowed HSM vendors by EOD.

dave: I'll draft the DPA addendum and drop it in the Drive folder.

maria: closing loop — deploy-bot status updated to ready at 1758006120. i'll update the thread if anything changes.
